Biography: 

Ardra B completed her Post Graduation in English Language and Literature from Sree Sankaracharya University of Sanskrit, Kerala, and her Undergraduate Programme in English and Communicative English from the University of Kerala. She qualified UGC NET and began her academic career in 2023 as a Guest Lecturer in English. Her teaching areas include Life Skills and Professional Communication.

           Her academic interests encompass Indian English Literature, Caste Studies, Marginal Voices in Literature, Malayalam Literature in English Translation, and Cultural Studies. She has presented research papers at national and international seminars on themes related to gender, caste, ecocriticism, and Indian literature.

A university rank holder in her Master's programme, Ardra is also a published writer and co-author of several anthology publications. She is passionate about literary research, writing, and exploring the intersections between literature, culture, and society.
